newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds slip as U.S. rate rise digested.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds slip as U.S. rate rise digested.

text.p: 1700 GMT - Austrian bonds eased on Wednesday as investors digested Tuesday's quarter point rise in the Federal Funds rate.
"Now the question is whether we will see more rate moves following after this one," said a trader. "But for tomorrow, we expect the market to move sideways, there won't be any spectacular moves."
Thursday will be the last trading day of the week as Austrian markets will remain closed for Good Friday.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 down 15 bps at 98.50 to yield 5.83 pct (5.81) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.55/63 to yield 5.82/81.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed steady at 98.05 in bourse trade to yield 4.83 pct, quoted post-market at 98.04/12 to yield 4.83/81 percent.
* AGB future down 10 bps at 107.53 on turnover of 661 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany up one at minus seven bps, five-year spread up seven at 12 bps.
* Money market rates higher with three-month VIBOR at 3.4 and overnight money at 3.16/3.41.
